entity.name: Lucky Nayak
entity.description: Student developer (Class 12, NIOS) from Faridabad, Haryana, India, and the sole maintainer of Kavach. Kavach has been designed, built, tested and shipped end to end from an Android phone running Termux: a Product Hunt launch, an 842-case adversarial red-team battery that passes clean, and CI (build, tests, race detector) on every pull request. Looking to move to full-time iteration on real hardware.

projects.name: Kavach
projects.description:
Kavach is an open-source Go inventory-reservation and booking engine for flash sales: e-commerce drops, tickets, hotels, events. It keeps high-concurrency booking systems from overselling with replay protection, idempotency keys, rate limiting, hold TTLs and multi-tenant auth. It launched on Product Hunt and passes an 842-case adversarial red-team battery clean (replay windows, HMAC tampering, rate-limit bypass, last-seat races, webhook abuse). CI runs build, tests and the race detector on every pull request.

Grant-period milestones: Q1 harden suspicious-activity monitoring and the red-team battery, publish a reproducible benchmark report; Q2 upgrade the in-repo Kavach Copilot assistant to cover monitor signals and deal profiles; Q3 one-click onboarding via Codespaces/Actions plus expanded examples and docs; Q4 full-suite reproducible verification and a public security write-up. At least one community engagement per quarter.

plans.description: One-time project grant, any amount helps (FOSS United's typical 3-7L INR project grant over a year fits). Milestones in the project description.
